items.hook: Is China catching up to the US and SpaceX on reusable rockets?
items.body: The next space race is not about making rockets faster, bigger or more capacious, but about reusing them reliably and cheaply. The US is well ahead, but can China catch up?

items.hook: The Girls of Slender Means is a novella written in 1963 by British author Muriel Spark.
items.body: It was included in Anthony Burgess's 1984 book Ninety-Nine Novels: The Best in English since 1939 — A Personal Choice. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Tomaszów Bolesławiecki is a railway station on the Miłkowice–Jasień railway in the village of Tomaszów Bolesławiecki, Bolesławiec County, within the Lower Silesian Voivodeship in south-western Poland.
items.body: One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: The Poseidon Adventure is a 2005 American made-for-television disaster film based on Paul Gallico's 1969 novel of the same name.
items.body: It is a remake of the 1972 film of the same name. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Jay-Z rape accuser says her allegation was false
items.body: A woman who accused Jay-Z of raping her when she was 13 now says she has never met the rap superstar.

items.hook: The Boston Globe–Horn Book Awards are a set of American literary awards conferred by The Boston Globe and The Horn Book Magazine annually from 1967.
items.body: One book is recognized in each of three categories: Fiction and Poetry, Nonfiction, and Picture Book. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: “Severe FOMO is an occupational pre-condition”: German buyers reveal the films for which they would bust the slate
items.body: Buyers from Pandora Film, DCM, X Verleih and Weltkino share insights on what is working at the German box office.

items.hook: A Woman Between Two Worlds is a 1936 Italian white telephone drama film directed by Goffredo Alessandrini and starring Isa Miranda, Assia Noris and Giulio Donadio.
items.body: The film's sets were designed by art director Hans Ledersteger. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Water for Elephants is a musical with music and lyrics by PigPen Theatre Co.
items.body: It is based on the 2006 novel of the same name by Sara Gruen. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.

items.hook: Juice to fly past Earth for third gravity assist
items.body: The European Space Agency’s Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer ( Juice ) will return to Earth on 28 September, with flight controllers guiding the spacecraft close to our home planet to alter its speed and direction en route to Jupiter.

items.hook: Anthropic’s discovery will, at best, be just another gene-editing tool
items.body: The AI company Anthropic has announced that its Claude large language model has discovered a system reminiscent of CRISPR, but that doesn’t mean the Nobel prizes will start rolling in, says Michael Le Page

items.hook: Jeffrey Moore is a Canadian writer, translator and educator currently living in Val-Morin in the Quebec Laurentians.
items.body: Moore was born in Montreal, and educated at the University of Toronto, BA, the Sorbonne and the University of Ottawa, MA. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.

items.hook: Some BBC channels and radio stations may well have to close, director general says
items.body: The BBC's financial situation "may well mean" some channels and stations close, Matt Brittin says.

items.hook: My dad was a monster! Sara Karloff on reviving Frankenstein, 95 years on
items.body:
Boris Karloff’s daughter and composer Michael Shapiro, whose musical score for the 1931 film is finally coming to London, talk about how it became a much-loved classic
